description: This file defines the TileLayerWMS class for integrating WMS (Web Map Service) layers into a Leaflet map. It extends the TileLayer class, providing options for WMS parameters, URL construction, and map integration.

classes.name: TileLayerWMS
classes.description: A class extending TileLayer to support WMS services as tile layers on a map.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the WMS layer with URL and options, merging default parameters with user options, and handling retina displays.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Method called when the layer is added to the map, setting CRS and WMS version, and calling the parent onAdd method.

methods.name: getTileUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for a specific tile based on coordinates, WMS parameters, and map projection.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Updates WMS parameters and optionally redraws the layer.
